services.name: Movement Classes
services.desc: This page features weekly homeschool art classes in Greensboro, NC. They are built around real technique, not just craft time. Students work through the Principles and Elements of Art, try a range of styles and mediums, and get into art history along the way. Structured enough to count as coursework, hands-on enough that it doesn't feel like it. Click on image to register. Session 2: October 19-December 14 (8-week session, no class week of November 23rd) Registrations must be made at least 48 hours in advance with a minimum of 3 kids to make the class. services.name: Yoga class
services.desc: No matter where you are on your movement journey, our classes are designed to meet you where you are, gently guiding you toward your personal goals with mindfulness, strength, and intention. Whether you’re a beginner learning the foundations, or an experienced yogi deepening your practice, our classes encourage you to listen to your body, honor your limits, and grow at your own pace in an environment that feels safe, inspiring, and uplifting. Yoga, Tai Chi and Taijiquan classes at The Marshall Muse Gallery aren’t only about movement. They are about helping you find your flow in life and creating space for calm, clarity, and creativity. Register below or contact Tracey if you are interested

services.desc: The Marshall Muse Gallery has several available rental spaces for your intimate creative events. Visit the pages below to learn more about the designated offering. If you’d like to offer a class or creative workshop, we may have just the space for you. If you want a place to work or exhibit your art, we cover that too! If you’re interested in signing up for an appointment or a rental tour, click here to sign up, or contact the gallery. Visit this page to learn how you can use these spaces for your private art gatherings.
